title: Rickety
tagline: Build a bridge on a budget. Press Go. Hope.
description: Drag planks, timber, steel and rope across a canyon, then watch an odd little robot drive a cart full of parcels over whatever you made. It will hold, sag, creak or collapse in a heap, and every beam shows how close it is to snapping. 24 levels, a new canyon every day where the cheapest bridge wins, and a sandbox for building silly things.
difficultyNote: Early bridges hold easily. Hitting par with every parcel delivered takes real engineering.
coverAlt: Illustration: an odd little robot drives a wobbly cart piled with parcels across a creaking wooden truss bridge over a deep valley, while other robots watch nervously from the cliffs.
